strategy: Five-color (WUBRG) midrange-control hybrid — Legacy Weapon's engine plus a 3-legend curve (Zur/Sol'kanar/Rith)
identity: WUBRG midrange-control hybrid splitting the rare budget between Legacy Weapon's repeatable exile engine and 3 curve-topping legends (Zur, Sol'kanar, Rith), backed by Birds of Paradise and common/uncommon 5-color fixing.

mainboard.name: Legacy Weapon
mainboard.oracle_text:
{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile target permanent.
If Legacy Weapon would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal Legacy Weapon and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.
mainboard.role: Repeatable WUBRG exile removal/lock engine (not a damage-dealing win condition itself)

mainboard.name: Rith, the Awakener
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever Rith deals combat damage to a player, you may pay {2}{G}. If you do, choose a color, then create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token for each permanent of that color.
mainboard.role: Curve-topping evasive threat; combat damage can convert into Saproling tokens

mainboard.name: Sol'kanar the Swamp King
mainboard.oracle_text:
Swampwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.)
Whenever a player casts a black spell, you gain 1 life.
mainboard.role: Evasive threat (swampwalk); gains life off any black spell cast

mainboard.name: Zur the Enchanter
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever Zur attacks, you may search your library for an enchantment card with mana value 3 or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
mainboard.role: Evasive threat; attack trigger puts an enchantment MV<=3 (Pacifism or Griffin Guide) directly onto the battlefield — this does NOT trigger Mesa Enchantress, since it's not cast

mainboard.name: Birds of Paradise
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
mainboard.role: Turn-1 mana acceleration and any-color fixing toward the top-heavy curve

mainboard.name: Swords to Plowshares
mainboard.oracle_text: Exile target creature. Its controller gains life equal to its power.
mainboard.role: Premium 1-mana creature removal

mainboard.name: Chain Lightning
mainboard.oracle_text: Chain Lightning deals 3 damage to any target. Then that player or that permanent's controller may pay {R}{R}. If the player does, they may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.
mainboard.role: Cheap burn removal / reach

mainboard.name: Terror
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target nonartifact, nonblack creature. It can't be regenerated.
mainboard.role: Efficient removal of nonartifact, nonblack creatures

mainboard.name: Counterspell
mainboard.oracle_text: Counter target spell.
mainboard.role: Hard counter protecting the plan

mainboard.name: Chainer's Edict
mainboard.oracle_text:
Target player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
Flashback {5}{B}{B} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
mainboard.role: Edict removal, has flashback for a second use

mainboard.name: Pacifism
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature can't attack or block.
mainboard.role: Cheap removal aura; a Zur/Mesa Enchantress target

mainboard.name: Flametongue Kavu
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, it deals 4 damage to target creature.
mainboard.role: ETB removal with a body

mainboard.name: Faceless Butcher
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, exile another target creature.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
mainboard.role: ETB exile removal with a body

mainboard.name: Radha, Heir to Keld
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever Radha attacks, you may add {R}{R}.
{T}: Add {G}.
mainboard.role: 2-drop body that ramps (taps for G, attack trigger adds RR) toward the curve-topping legends

mainboard.name: Mogg War Marshal
mainboard.oracle_text:
Echo {1}{R} (At the beginning of your upkeep, if this came under your control since the beginning of your last upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay its echo cost.)
When this creature enters or dies, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
mainboard.role: 2-drop that makes 2 bodies for early defense while the legends come online

mainboard.name: Impulse
mainboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
mainboard.role: Card selection to find answers/lands/legends

mainboard.name: Mind Stone
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Ramp toward the curve-topping legends; cashes in for a card late

mainboard.name: Mesa Enchantress
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you may draw a card.
mainboard.role: Card draw payoff, but only triggers on hard-casting Pacifism/Griffin Guide from hand (not off Zur's tutor) — a shallow, 2-enchantment upside package

mainboard.name: Griffin Guide
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has flying.
When enchanted creature dies, create a 2/2 white Griffin creature token with flying.
mainboard.role: Aura that turns any creature into a resilient flying threat; a Zur/Mesa Enchantress target

mainboard.name: Man-o'-War
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, return target creature to its owner's hand.
mainboard.role: Tempo bounce with a body, buys time for the curve to develop

mainboard.name: Thieving Magpie
mainboard.oracle_text:

mainboard.role: Evasive threat generating card advantage

mainboard.name: Fact or Fiction
mainboard.oracle_text: Reveal the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
